data.long_meaning: Bimay is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhima’ which means ‘strong’ and ‘Bima’ meaning ‘god’s grace’. This name is associated with strength, courage, and protection from the divine. The name Bimay carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bimay usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
